recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-33266 cleanup across active current-spec inputs while respecting later R6 EvidenceVariable and RelativeTime changes; any broader model-info drift unrelated to timeFromStart should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-33266 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested removal of EvidenceVariable.characteristic.timeFromStart because timeFromEvent could express study start, plus creation of an EvidenceVariableEvent example value set containing study-start, hospital-admission, hospital-discharge, and operative-procedure.
initial_application: Commit 9a5e8d697fe3458a047e1763344abc4231e9e2c6 (J# 33266) removed timeFromStart from the EvidenceVariable StructureDefinition, updated examples from timeFromStart to timeFromEvent, and added EvidenceVariableEvent CodeSystem/ValueSet. Current authoritative EvidenceVariable and terminology source already reflected that main change, but active narrative/model-info inputs still mentioned timeFromStart.
additional_context: FHIR-42886 later removed EvidenceVariable.characteristic in favor of EvidenceVariable.definition referencing Group, and FHIR-41582 introduced RelativeTime for event-relative timing. The remaining source/fhir.ini timeFromStart reference is in the [r4-r6-changes] compatibility mapping, documenting the old path as removed rather than advertising it as current.
reconciliation: Updated source/clinicalreasoning-topics-definitional-resources.html to describe EvidenceVariable.definition and a referenced Group with Group.characteristic.relativeTime, replacing the stale timeFromStart table row and example. Removed the stale timeFromStart element from source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml.
